description:
Target: JSONPlaceholder (API_BASE_URL in config/env/*.env)

  Objective: the API must handle boundary and invalid data during post creation
  without server-side failures, and should reject invalid input with a 4xx and an
  error message.

  JSONPlaceholder is a mock that does not validate input, so the scenarios are split:
    * untagged  — behaviour that MUST hold (no 5xx, data integrity). Gate the build.
    * @known-issue — the contract the spec asks for. These currently FAIL and are
      reported as defects (see README "Defects found"). Run with: npm run test:known-issues

elements.name: Valid post is created (positive control)

steps.name: I have a post payload with a valid post
I submit the post
the response status should be 201
the response should echo the submitted fields with a new id
the response should arrive within the configured time limit

description:
As a borrower planning my finances
  I want a year-by-year breakdown of my repayments
  So that I can see how much of each year's payments go to interest

elements.name: Report page loads with its parameter form

steps.name: I am on the amortization report page
the amortization report page should be displayed
no report should be shown until I generate one

elements.name: Generated report matches my own amortization schedule

steps.name: I am on the amortization report page
I generate a report for a loan of 2500000 rupees at 10% for 10 years starting "2026-03"
the report summary should match my independently calculated values
the report should state 120 EMIs closing in "Feb 2036"
the schedule should have one row per calendar year of the loan
every yearly row should match my independently calculated amortization
the balance after the final year should be zero

elements.name: Bar chart shows one bar per year and a tooltip with that year's figures

steps.name: I am on the amortization report page
I generate a report for a loan of 1000000 rupees at 12% for 5 years starting "2026-07"
the yearly bar chart should be visible
the bar chart should contain 6 bars
every bar should show non-zero principal and interest
I hover over the bar for 2028
the tooltip should show the 2028 figures from my independently calculated amortization

elements.name: Filtering the schedule to a single year shows its monthly instalments

steps.name: I am on the amortization report page
I generate a report for a loan of 5000000 rupees at 7.5% for 15 years starting "2026-01"
I filter the schedule to show monthly instalments for 2027
the schedule should list 12 monthly instalments for 2027
every monthly row should match my independently calculated instalments
the bar for 2027 should be highlighted

elements.name: Loan details flow from the dashboard into the report

steps.name: I am on the loan dashboard
I calculate a loan of 5000000 rupees at 7.5% for 15 years
I open the amortization report from the dashboard
the report form should be prefilled with 5000000 rupees at 7.5% for 15 years
the report summary should match my independently calculated values

elements.name: Invalid report parameters are rejected — loan amount

steps.name: I am on the amortization report page
I generate a report for a loan of 0 rupees at 10% for 10 years starting "2026-01"
I should see the report error "Loan amount must be between 10,000 and 10,00,00,000."
no report should be shown until I generate one

elements.name: Invalid report parameters are rejected — interest rate

steps.name: I am on the amortization report page
I generate a report for a loan of 2500000 rupees at 45% for 10 years starting "2026-01"
I should see the report error "Interest rate must be between 0.1 and 30."
no report should be shown until I generate one

elements.name: Invalid report parameters are rejected — tenure

steps.name: I am on the amortization report page
I generate a report for a loan of 2500000 rupees at 10% for 31 years starting "2026-01"
I should see the report error "Loan tenure must be between 1 and 30."
no report should be shown until I generate one

name: Amortization report

description:
As a prospective borrower
  I want to see my monthly EMI, total interest and repayment split
  So that I understand the real cost of a loan before I take it

  Expected figures are always computed by the test suite's own calculator
  (src/utils/loanCalculator.ts), never read back from the application.

elements.name: Dashboard loads with the default home loan figures

steps.name: I am on the loan dashboard
the loan dashboard should be displayed
the "Home Loan" tab should be selected
the summary should show a monthly EMI, total interest and total payment
the summary should match my own calculation for the values in the form

elements.name: EMI for a Home Loan of 2500000 at 10% over 10 years matches an independently computed value

steps.name: I am on the loan dashboard
I select the "Home Loan" tab
I calculate a loan of 2500000 rupees at 10% for 10 years
the monthly EMI should match my independently calculated EMI
the total interest and total payment should match my independently calculated values

elements.name: EMI for a Home Loan of 5000000 at 7.5% over 15 years matches an independently computed value

steps.name: I am on the loan dashboard
I select the "Home Loan" tab
I calculate a loan of 5000000 rupees at 7.5% for 15 years
the monthly EMI should match my independently calculated EMI
the total interest and total payment should match my independently calculated values

elements.name: EMI for a Personal Loan of 1000000 at 12% over 5 years matches an independently computed value

steps.name: I am on the loan dashboard
I select the "Personal Loan" tab
I calculate a loan of 1000000 rupees at 12% for 5 years
the monthly EMI should match my independently calculated EMI
the total interest and total payment should match my independently calculated values

elements.name: EMI for a Car Loan of 750000 at 8.75% over 7 years matches an independently computed value

steps.name: I am on the loan dashboard
I select the "Car Loan" tab
I calculate a loan of 750000 rupees at 8.75% for 7 years
the monthly EMI should match my independently calculated EMI
the total interest and total payment should match my independently calculated values

elements.name: Moving the tenure slider recalculates the figures

steps.name: I am on the loan dashboard
I move the "Loan tenure" slider to 20
the "Loan tenure" input should show 20
the summary should match my own calculation for the values in the form

elements.name: Payment breakdown pie chart renders valid, non-zero data

steps.name: I am on the loan dashboard
I calculate a loan of 2500000 rupees at 10% for 10 years
the payment breakdown pie chart should be visible
both pie chart segments should have values greater than zero
the principal segment should equal the loan amount
the interest segment should equal my independently calculated total interest
the pie chart legend should show the same values as the segments

elements.name: Out-of-range loan amount is rejected with a helpful message

steps.name: I am on the loan dashboard
I calculate a loan of 50000 rupees at 10% for 10 years
I should see the validation message "Loan amount must be between ₹1,00,000 and ₹2,00,00,000."
the summary figures should be cleared
the pie chart should be replaced by an empty-state message

elements.name: Out-of-range interest rate is rejected with a helpful message

steps.name: I am on the loan dashboard
I calculate a loan of 2500000 rupees at 25% for 10 years
I should see the validation message "Interest rate must be between 5% and 20%."
the summary figures should be cleared
the pie chart should be replaced by an empty-state message

elements.name: Out-of-range tenure is rejected with a helpful message

steps.name: I am on the loan dashboard
I calculate a loan of 2500000 rupees at 10% for 0 years
I should see the validation message "Loan tenure must be between 1 year and 30 years."
the summary figures should be cleared
the pie chart should be replaced by an empty-state message
